author: GovRonDeSantis
text:
Florida’s per-capita tax burden is one of the lowest in the nation.

Since I became governor, we have enacted billions of dollars in tax cuts. This year’s hunting, fishing and camping sales tax holiday—ongoing through December 31—will provide Floridians with even more tax relief. We are proud to protect Floridians’ Second Amendment rights while helping hunters, anglers, and sportsmen keep more of their hard-earned money.

Visit http://FloridaRevenue.com/HuntFishCamp for a full list of items you can purchase tax-free for all your outdoor recreation needs.
